question: When we arrange things like a bowl and an apple to draw them, what do we call it? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! When we arrange non-moving objects like fruits or pots to draw them, it is called a still life arrangement! 🏺
hint: The objects do not move, they sit 'still'.

question: If you place an apple in front of a big jug, what happens to the jug in your drawing? 🍎🏺
explanation: Great job! The object in front always hides a small part of the object placed behind it. 🙈
hint: The apple covers a piece of it.

question: What is it called when one object covers a part of another object? 📦🍎
explanation: Super! Overlapping is a cool art trick where things in front cover things in the back! 🎨

question: Where is the best place to draw your main object on the paper? 📄
explanation: Brilliant! Placing your main drawing near the center makes it look very nice and balanced! 🎯

question: How do we make an object look like it is very close to us? 👀
explanation: Awesome! Things that are closer to us always look bigger than things far away! 🐘

question: How do we make an object look like it is far away? 🏞️
explanation: Perfect! When objects are far away, they look much smaller to our eyes. 🐜

question: Before starting to draw, what should we do with our objects? 🏺🍎
explanation: Great job! We must arrange our objects together nicely so our drawing looks beautiful! ✨
hint: Put them in a good order.

question: When arranging objects, what makes the drawing look very interesting? 🤩
explanation: Super! Using tall, short, big, and small objects together makes your art super fun to look at! 🐘🐜

question: What shape is a simple apple when we start drawing it? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! We can start drawing round fruits like apples by making a simple circle first! ⭕
hint: It is round like a ball.

question: What shape is a tall glass of water when we start drawing it? 🥛
explanation: Brilliant! A glass is shaped like a cylinder, which is round but very tall! 🥫
hint: It looks like a tin can.

question: To draw a nice still life, where should we place our group of objects? 🏺🍎
explanation: Great job! Placing objects on a flat table helps them stay still while we draw them! 🪑

question: What helps us see the objects and gives them nice shadows? ☀️
explanation: Super! Good lighting helps us see the shapes clearly and makes cool shadows to draw! 💡
hint: It comes from a lamp or the sun.

question: If an apple is placed exactly behind a big box, can we see the apple? 📦🍎
explanation: Awesome! If something is fully behind a bigger object, it gets completely hidden from our eyes. 🙈
hint: The big box covers it completely.

question: When an object blocks the light, what dark shape does it make on the table? 🌑
explanation: Perfect! Objects block the bright light and create cool dark shadows on the table! 👤
hint: It is dark and follows you.

question: How much space should a drawing take on your paper? 📄
explanation: Brilliant! A good drawing uses a lot of the paper space so everyone can see it clearly! 🌟

question: What is the flat space where the objects sit called? 🪑
explanation: Super! The flat area like a table where objects rest is called the base or ground line! 🟩
hint: The bottom part where things rest.

question: If we draw a tall bottle, where should a small lemon go to look nice? 🍋🍾
explanation: Awesome! Placing a small object in front of a tall object creates a beautiful overlapping arrangement! 🍋

question: Why do we arrange objects before drawing them? 🎨
explanation: Great job! We arrange things carefully so our final artwork looks balanced and super beautiful! ✨
hint: To make it look very pretty.

question: What line shows where the table ends and the wall begins? ➖
explanation: Super! The horizon line separates the table surface from the background wall in our drawing! 🌅

question: Which objects make a great still life drawing? 🏺
explanation: Awesome! Fruits, pots, and toys are great because they sit perfectly still while we draw! 🍎

question: When arranging two identical cups, how can we make it look fun? ☕☕
explanation: Brilliant! Letting one cup slightly cover the other makes the drawing look very real and fun! ✨
hint: Put one a little bit in front.

question: If you are drawing a big pumpkin and a small grape, which takes more space on paper? 🎃🍇
explanation: Great job! A big pumpkin will always need a much bigger space on your drawing paper! 🎃

question: What do we call the empty space around our drawn objects? 📄
explanation: Awesome! The empty white paper around our beautiful drawing is called negative space! ⬜

question: What is the space filled by the objects called? 🍎
explanation: Super! The space that your fruits and pots actually take up is called positive space! ⬛

question: What tool helps us lightly sketch the shapes first? ✏️
explanation: Perfect! A light pencil helps us draw shapes easily and we can erase mistakes without any trouble! ✏️
hint: It has an eraser on top.

question: What should we do if our drawing looks too small on a big paper? 📄
explanation: Great job! We can just use our eraser and draw the objects a little bigger to fill the nice paper! 🐘

question: When objects touch each other in an arrangement, they look like a... 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
explanation: Awesome! When we place objects close so they touch or overlap, they become a beautiful group! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

question: What part of an object should we draw first? 🏺
explanation: Brilliant! Always draw the simple basic shape like a circle or square first before adding details! ⭕

question: If a light shines from the left, where will the dark shadow be? ☀️
explanation: Super! The shadow always falls on the opposite side of where the bright light is coming from! 👉

question: What makes a drawing of an apple look 3D and round? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Adding soft pencil shading makes flat shapes look real, round, and super 3D! ✏️

question: To show depth, we draw the closest object... 👀
explanation: Great job! Objects that are very close to us are usually drawn lower on the paper! ⬇️

question: What do we call the way all objects are placed together on paper? 🖼️
explanation: Perfect! Composition is the artist's word for planning and arranging everything beautifully on the page! 🎨

question: What is the best way to practice drawing arrangements? ✏️
explanation: Super! Looking and observing your objects very carefully makes your drawing look amazing and real! 👀

question: If you place a banana behind an apple, the banana is in the... 🍌
explanation: Awesome! Things placed behind other objects are in the back, which is called the background! 🏞️

question: The apple in front of the banana is in the... 🍎
explanation: Brilliant! The object closest to you, sitting right in the front, is in the foreground! 🖼️

question: How should we hold our pencil when sketching lightly? ✏️
explanation: Great job! Holding the pencil gently helps us make soft, light lines that are easy to change! ✋

question: What shape can we use to draw a nice book? 📖
explanation: Awesome! A book has straight sides and corners, so a rectangle is the perfect starting shape! ▭

question: What happens when objects are spaced too far apart? ↔️
explanation: Super! When objects are too far apart, the drawing loses its connection and the objects look lonely. 🧍
hint: They look like they have no friends.

question: What helps keep our drawing paper safe and smooth? 📎
explanation: Perfect! A hard, flat drawing board keeps our paper perfectly smooth while we create art! 📋

question: What do we use to remove a pencil mistake? 🧽
explanation: Great job! An eraser easily cleans up light pencil lines so we can try again perfectly! 🧼

question: If you look at a bowl from the top, what shape does it look like? 🥣
explanation: Awesome! Looking straight down into a round bowl makes it look just like a perfect flat circle! ⭕

question: If you look at the same bowl from the side, the top looks like an... 🥣
explanation: Brilliant! Viewing round things from the side squishes the circle shape into a beautiful oval! 🥚

question: What is an important rule for drawing still life? 🏺
explanation: Super! The best artists always look closely and draw exactly what their eyes can see! 👀
hint: Look very carefully at the object.

question: How do we create an arrangement that is not boring? 🌟
explanation: Great job! Mixing tall pots, small fruits, and cool shapes makes your artwork super exciting! 🍎🏺
hint: Use a fruit and a pot together.

question: Can we draw a soft cloth behind our fruits? 🧣🍎
explanation: Awesome! Placing a beautiful folded cloth behind your objects adds lovely colors and textures! ✨

question: If a drawing feels 'balanced', what does that mean? ⚖️
explanation: Perfect! A balanced drawing fills the paper nicely so one side is not too empty or too crowded! 🌟

question: What is a fun way to practice overlapping? 🎨
explanation: Super! Putting one hand in front of the other and drawing them is a great way to learn overlapping! ✋🤚

question: When arranging objects, the tallest object usually looks best... 📏
explanation: Brilliant! Placing tall objects in the back lets us easily see all the smaller objects in front! 🐘

question: If you color the apple dark red, what happens to the drawing? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Adding beautiful colors and shading makes flat drawings pop out and look super solid! 🌟

question: What is the best thing about making an art arrangement? 🎨
explanation: Great job! Art is all about expressing yourself, being creative, and having lots of fun! ✨
